# Kaaveri Tours and Travels

> Travel desk in Jyoti Nagar, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (formerly Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India. Handles enquiries for heritage and temple day trips, one-way travel and corporate employee transport. Enquiries are answered by phone or WhatsApp in English or Marathi. There is no online booking, no fixed packages and no published prices: every trip is arranged after an enquiry.

## Services

- [Heritage and temple tours](https://kaaveritoursandtravels.com/tourism): trips from Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar to Ajanta Caves, Ellora Caves, Ghrishneshwar, Trimbakeshwar and Bhimashankar.
- [One-way travel](https://kaaveritoursandtravels.com/one-way-travel): point-to-point journeys without a return trip.
- [Corporate employee transport](https://kaaveritoursandtravels.com/corporate-travel): employee pickup, drop and shift transport for companies.
- [Vehicle classes](https://kaaveritoursandtravels.com/vehicles): sedan (up to four passengers) and seven-seater SUV. Photos on the site are illustrative examples, not Kaaveri's own vehicles.
